snippet.title: Cralon - Morass Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
Cralon is an authentic 3D immersive sim dungeon crawler with RPG and adventure elements, inspired by the ultimate dungeon classics. 

Wishlists appreciated!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3440060/Cralon/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/de/p/cralon-12e9d3
Website: https://pithead-studio.com/

Hunting a demon, you fell into the abyss of an old mine. Equip yourself, fight creatures, solve quests, uncover secrets and find a way out.

#cralon #pithead #pitheadstudio #indiedev #gamedev #dungeoncrawl #immersivesim
